purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Tuban

queries.query: Tuban Indonesia official cadastral map parcel GIS land registry ATR BPN
queries.result: First-party discovery identified ATR/BPN's BHUMI public geospatial viewer and ATLAS portal, plus an official Tuban Regency report of BPN Tuban parcel-map work. It did not identify a public anonymous Tuban parcel API response.

queries.query: Tuban peta bidang tanah resmi ATR BPN GIS
queries.result: First-party Indonesian-language discovery identified the official BHUMI layer named Bidang Tanah and official Tuban Regency evidence describing 50,108 Peta Bidang Tanah across 23 villages. The public viewer's parcel request path requires an authorization token; no safe anonymous ID+geometry response was obtained.

registryEvidence.custodian: Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Tuban / BPN Tuban, within Indonesia's Ministry of Agrarian Affairs and Spatial Planning/National Land Agency (ATR/BPN)
registryEvidence.scopeNote: The official Tuban Regency publication directly identifies BPN Tuban parcel-map activity and counts Peta Bidang Tanah; this evidences a local cadastral custodian/procedure, not open citywide downloadable coverage.

parcelDiscovery.note: BHUMI's current JavaScript/configuration exposes the official Geoserver layer umum:Persil at /bhumigs/umum and safe display fields penggunaan, tipehak, luas, nib, and akurasibidang. The parcel API route /expapi/getPersil returned 401 to an unauthenticated POST; no credentials, hardcoded viewer login, private token, or unsafe fields were used. No parcel polygon was retained.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identity if publicly exposed
non-personal classification fields such as area/use/right-type when explicitly public
uncertainty: The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted; no exact-point hit or miss was used as an absence test.

BHUMI's public map exposes a parcel layer configuration, but its parcel retrieval route returned 401 anonymously and direct WMS/WFS capability URLs returned 404; this does not establish citywide absence.
The official Tuban publication establishes local BPN cadastral activity and procedure, not complete public polygon coverage or a stable native parcel-ID schema.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, certificate, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration or admission.
